card.name: Iron and iron-related terms
card.fires_on: The word iron (or Iron) and the start of iron-root words like siderin, siderosis and sideroblastic, in drug-label text about iron, iron overload or chelation.

modes.label: The word iron
modes.description: The word iron itself, in chelation, overload or overdose text.

modes.label: Sider- word parts
modes.description: The middle part of words built on the Greek root for iron, such as hemosiderin or sideroblastic.

card.writes: It pushes toward iron and metal words, such as iron and alloy, including in Chinese.
card.plain: It lights up on iron and on medical words that contain the iron root, like hemosiderin.
